metadata.question: Does location (33.97811334086217, -118.2436826460509) at Los Angeles have a higher average nitrogen dioxide concentration than location (32.7358717958782,-117.15380986802357) San Diego from 2018 to 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2: primary OFFL collection (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) for 2018-01-01 to 2020-01-01. If empty, fallback to NRTI (COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2).
   - Two points: Los Angeles (-118.24368, 33.97811) and San Diego (-117.15381, 32.73587), each buffered by 10 km.

2. Masking strategy.
   - Apply recommended QA mask: qa_value >= 0.75. This is not cloud percentage, but ensures valid retrievals.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error.
   - Immediately check collection size; if 0 and fallback also 0 → C1.
   - After QA mask, compute per-region valid pixel count using count().gt(0) over the time series. If either region has 0 valid pixels → C2.
   - Compute regional mean NO2; if null/NaN → C3.
   - Compare LA mean > SD mean → A (Yes) else B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2018-01-01';
    const end = '2020-01-01'; // inclusive end-exclusive window covers 2018-2019
    const laPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.2436826460509, 33.97811334086217]);
    const sdPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-117.15380986802357, 32.7358717958782]);
    const bufferKm = 10;
    const laBuf = laPt.buffer(bufferKm * 1000);
    const sdBuf = sdPt.buffer(bufferKm * 1000);
    const band = 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density';

    function getInfoAsync(obj) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        try {
          obj.getInfo((res) => resolve(res));
        } catch (e) { reject(e); }
      });
    }
    function fmtSci(x) {
      if (x === null || x === undefined) return 'null';
      if (Number.isNaN(x)) return 'NaN';
      return Number(x).toExponential(2);
    }
    function pct(a, b) {
      if (!isFinite(a) || !isFinite(b) || b === 0) return 'NaN';
      return (100 * a / b).toFixed(1) + '%';
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let baseCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']);
    let sizeOffl = await getInfoAsync(baseCol.size());
    let source = 'OFFL';
    if (sizeOffl === 0) {
      let ntri = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']);
      const sizeNtri = await getInfoAsync(ntri.size());
      if (sizeNtri === 0) {
        console.log(`Time: ${start} to 2019-12-31`);
        console.log('No data in OFFL or NRTI collections for this period.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
      baseCol = ntri;
      source = 'NRTI';
      sizeOffl = sizeNtri;
    }

    // Masking by QA >= 0.75 (recommended)
    const maskedCol = baseCol.map(function (img) {
      const qa = img.select('qa_value');
      const m = qa.gte(0.75);
      return img.updateMask(m);
    });
    const no2Col = maskedCol.select(band);

    // 3. Processing: counts and means
    const meanImg = no2Col.mean();
    const countImg = no2Col.count().rename('count');

    // Valid pixel counts (pixels in buffer that have at least one valid observation)
    const validImg = countImg.gt(0).rename('valid');
    const totalPixImg = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one');

    const laValidPix = await getInfoAsync(validImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: laBuf,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('valid'));
    const sdValidPix = await getInfoAsync(validImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: sdBuf,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('valid'));
    const laTotalPix = await getInfoAsync(totalPixImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: laBuf,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('one'));
    const sdTotalPix = await getInfoAsync(totalPixImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: sdBuf,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('one'));
    if ((laValidPix || 0) === 0 || (sdValidPix || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`Time: ${start} to 2019-12-31`);
      console.log(`Collection: ${source} images=${sizeOffl}, QA>=0.75`);
      console.log(`LA valid pixels: ${laValidPix || 0}/${laTotalPix || 0} (${pct(laValidPix || 0, laTotalPix || 0)})`);
      console.log(`SD valid pixels: ${sdValidPix || 0}/${sdTotalPix || 0} (${pct(sdValidPix || 0, sdTotalPix || 0)})`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const laMeanNO2 = await getInfoAsync(meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: laBuf,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get(band));
    const sdMeanNO2 = await getInfoAsync(meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: sdBuf,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get(band));

    const laObsPerPix = await getInfoAsync(countImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: laBuf,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('count'));
    const sdObsPerPix = await getInfoAsync(countImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: sdBuf,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
    }).get('count'));

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Time: ${start} to 2019-12-31`);
    console.log(`Collection: ${source} images=${sizeOffl}, QA>=0.75`);
    console.log(`LA valid pixels: ${laValidPix}/${laTotalPix} (${pct(laValidPix, laTotalPix)}), avg obs/pix: ${Number(laObsPerPix || 0).toFixed(1)}, mean NO2: ${fmtSci(laMeanNO2)} mol/m^2`);
    console.log(`SD valid pixels: ${sdValidPix}/${sdTotalPix} (${pct(sdValidPix, sdTotalPix)}), avg obs/pix: ${Number(sdObsPerPix || 0).toFixed(1)}, mean NO2: ${fmtSci(sdMeanNO2)} mol/m^2`);

    if (laMeanNO2 === null || sdMeanNO2 === null || Number.isNaN(laMeanNO2) || Number.isNaN(sdMeanNO2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const higher = Number(laMeanNO2) > Number(sdMeanNO2);
    console.log(`Comparison LA>SD: ${higher}`);
    console.log(higher ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${String(err).slice(0, 200)}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
